statusDetail: Coverage complete. Public Angular entry plus representative services, examination, contact, and login routes were exercised; all destination routes redirected to a shared #/500 state.

page.notes: Production entry redirects to /ExaminationServices/. Representative route requests redirect cross-origin to testservices.nic.in/ExaminationServices/#/500 while re-rendering the homepage shell.

checkOutcomes.evidence: Heap self size rose only 143,819 bytes (0.77%) and nodes 1,438 (0.40%) across separate controlled runs, with no unbounded pattern established.

principleOutcomes.reason: WebMCP capability exposure is emerging and not required for this informational portal; its crawlability opportunity is already covered under discoverability. No summarization or language-model task needs on-device inference on this simple portal.

paths.description: Public entry and dashboard template; tested desktop, 360x800, dark/reduced preferences, keyboard semantics, performance, network, security, no-JS, and memory.
Primary service/detail navigation archetype; direct route traversal.
Exam listing archetype and core discovery journey; direct route traversal.
Support/contact journey and recovery surface; direct route traversal.
Authentication entry and primary transactional journey; direct route traversal.

findings.summary: The interface ignores the user’s dark color-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: The dark-condition screenshot is pixel-identical in palette and file size (179,048 bytes) to the default capture; no color-scheme media rule was found.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and retint surfaces with prefers-color-scheme or light-dark().

findings.summary: Text and controls do not consistently survive enhanced-contrast needs.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed color-contrast and the stylesheet probe found no prefers-contrast handling.
findings.suggestedFix: Correct failing contrast pairs and add forced-colors/prefers-contrast adaptations.

findings.summary: Route changes are abrupt and, more importantly, fail before a meaningful transition can occur.
findings.evidence: Every tested route jumped to testservices.nic.in/ExaminationServices/#/500 with no transition or destination state.
findings.suggestedFix: Repair routing first, then use same-document view transitions for stable route changes.

findings.summary: Navigation chrome does not respond to scroll position.
findings.evidence: The large government banner and navigation remain static chrome; no progress or scroll-state response was found.
findings.suggestedFix: Use sticky state-aware chrome or a compact progress affordance when users move down the long page.

findings.summary: Primary navigation loses the user in an undifferentiated error route.
findings.evidence: Services, Examinations, Contact, and Login all redirect to the same #/500 state while rendering the homepage, with no error or destination cue.
findings.suggestedFix: Fix route targets and expose current-page state, focus movement, and a visible failure message.

findings.summary: The first viewport gives more space to institutional chrome and dashboard decoration than direct exam actions.
findings.evidence: Government masthead, oversized title block, full-width navigation, carousel, chart, and statistic cards crowd the first view before useful exam links.
findings.suggestedFix: Compress the masthead and prioritize a concise, task-oriented exam list.

findings.summary: The page renders a desktop-width layout on mobile.
findings.evidence: The layout reported scrollWidth 751 against a 360px visual viewport, 391px horizontal overflow.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace fixed widths with intrinsic/fluid layout and verify no overflow at narrow widths.

findings.summary: Components do not adapt to their available container.
findings.evidence: Reusable masthead/navigation/chart components remain 751px wide at a 360px viewport; no container-query evidence was found.
findings.suggestedFix: Introduce container boundaries and size-aware component rules.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus is frequently invisible and several targets are undersized.
findings.evidence: Many links, carousel controls, cards, logo links, and footer links computed to outline:none and box-shadow:none; footer links are only 17px tall.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply a consistent :focus-visible ring and enlarge compact touch targets.

findings.summary: Users can see exam information but cannot identify a reliable primary action.
findings.evidence: The platform purpose is stated, but the visible exam URLs have no href and the “Home” item points to /login.
findings.suggestedFix: Make each current exam a descriptive real link and correct the Home destination.

findings.summary: Primary navigation and login flows cannot be completed.
findings.evidence: All four representative destinations ended at testservices.nic.in/ExaminationServices/#/500 and displayed the same shell instead of their requested content.
findings.suggestedFix: Correct production routing/base href and add route smoke tests for all public and login destinations.

findings.summary: The system hides a server/error state instead of helping users recover.
findings.evidence: The #/500 URL shows the normal homepage with no error explanation, retry, back, or recovery action.
findings.suggestedFix: Render an explicit accessible error state with retry, Home, and contact/support paths.

findings.summary: Largest Contentful Paint is outside the good range.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 4.82s and TBT 203ms; the trace measured LCP 3.94s and two long tasks.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the LCP resource, compress critical delivery, and defer non-critical work.

findings.summary: Main-thread work delays interactivity.
findings.evidence: The trace recorded 2 long tasks (99ms longest); Lighthouse reported 2.8s main-thread work and 203ms TBT.
findings.suggestedFix: Chunk non-critical work, remove redundant libraries, and schedule low-priority tasks later.

findings.summary: Critical resources are oversized, uncached, and render delaying.
findings.evidence: The page transfers 1.72MB; a 928KB uncompressed stylesheet lacks cache headers, parser scripts are high priority, and font-display costs about 1.02s.
findings.suggestedFix: Compress and cache hashed assets, inline only critical CSS, defer classic scripts, and set font-display.

findings.summary: Substantial unused and overlapping code ships on the entry page.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 147KiB unused CSS and 146KiB unused JS; the page also ships jQuery, Bootstrap, admin scripts, and Angular.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove unused CSS/JS and eliminate legacy libraries where Angular/platform code already provides the behavior.

findings.summary: Controls, links, and images lack reliable accessible names and roles.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed aria-input-field-name, aria-required-children, image-alt and link-name; 3 of 6 images lack alt.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide semantic controls, names, required ARIA children, and appropriate alt text.

findings.summary: Foreground/background contrast is insufficient in visible content.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed the color-contrast audit on the rendered homepage.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust color tokens until all normal and large text meet WCAG contrast thresholds.

findings.summary: Heading, landmark, and focus structure does not provide a coherent keyboard/AT path.
findings.evidence: There is no h1 or main landmark; heading order fails, and many focused controls have no visible outline.
findings.suggestedFix: Add main and h1, repair heading order, and enforce visible focus in DOM order.

findings.summary: Text is clipped or forced into an oversized layout.
findings.evidence: At desktop the title/subtitle is clipped behind the navigation, and the mobile page is wider than the viewport.
findings.suggestedFix: Use fluid type/spacing and allow masthead text to wrap without overlap.

findings.summary: The page does not reflow and compact targets are hard to activate.
findings.evidence: At 360px the page overflows by 391px; multiple footer targets are 17px tall.
findings.suggestedFix: Meet 400% zoom/reflow behavior and enlarge interactive hit areas.

findings.summary: The production page logs browser errors.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reported browser errors in the console.
findings.suggestedFix: Resolve failing requests/runtime exceptions and enforce a clean-console smoke test.

findings.summary: Image assets are not robustly sized or delivered.
findings.evidence: Document/charset are valid, but all 6 images omit dimensions, 5 use legacy PNG/JPG, and one is oversized.
findings.suggestedFix: Add width/height, responsive sources, lazy loading, and modern formats where useful.

findings.summary: Production diagnostics are incomplete and platform errors remain.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found missing source maps for large first-party JavaScript and browser console errors.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish protected source maps to monitoring and remove browser errors/deprecations.

findings.summary: The page has no search-result description.
findings.evidence: The title is descriptive, but meta description is absent.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a concise unique meta description matching the public examination service.

findings.summary: Core content and navigation are not reliably crawlable.
findings.evidence: Non-JS coverage is 2%; several visible links have no href; robots.txt returns an error redirect document and Lighthouse reports 14 robots errors.
findings.suggestedFix: Server-render meaningful content and real links; serve a valid robots.txt.

findings.summary: Canonical, robots, and sitemap signals are inconsistent or missing.
findings.evidence: No canonical is present; robots.txt and sitemap.xml both return a JavaScript error redirect with HTTP 200.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve valid robots/sitemap resources and add a canonical for the public route.

findings.summary: Search and share clients receive no structured entity or preview metadata.
findings.evidence: The organization/examination page exposes no JSON-LD or Open Graph metadata.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate Organization/WebSite and relevant exam metadata plus Open Graph fields.

findings.summary: The CSP weakens XSS protection with unsafe-inline.
findings.evidence: HTTPS, HSTS, nosniff, and secure no-cookie state pass, but CSP permits unsafe-inline for scripts and styles.
findings.suggestedFix: Move inline code/styles to nonce/hash-protected resources and tighten CSP.

findings.summary: Browser-enforced policy defenses are only partial.
findings.evidence: Permissions-Policy is missing, Referrer-Policy is legacy no-referrer-when-downgrade, and CSP has unsafe-inline, although HSTS and X-Frame-Options are present.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a restrictive Permissions-Policy, strict-origin-when-cross-origin or stricter referrer policy, and nonce/hash CSP.

findings.summary: Core public exam content disappears without JavaScript.
findings.evidence: Raw HTML provides only 2% of rendered content and the crawler screenshot is blank; the Angular page is a JS shell.
findings.suggestedFix: Server-render or prerender core headings, exam links, and navigation, then enhance with Angular.

findings.summary: Runtime routing is fragile across the primary navigation.
findings.evidence: Every tested destination resolves to a #/500 state and silently re-renders the homepage.
findings.suggestedFix: Fix route configuration and add production-origin navigation tests with explicit error boundaries.

findings.summary: HTTP/runtime failure states are misleading and unrecoverable.
findings.evidence: The #/500 state contains no visible error, retry, stale-data warning, or recovery action.
findings.suggestedFix: Render explicit 404/500/network states with retry and safe navigation.

findings.summary: Mixed-language content is not semantically identified for assistive technology.
findings.evidence: The page mixes Hindi and English branding while declaring only lang=en; no direction metadata or translation affordance is present.
findings.suggestedFix: Mark language changes, retain correct html lang/dir, and use logical layout properties.

findings.summary: Image delivery wastes bytes and misses responsive/lazy loading.
findings.evidence: Five of six images are legacy PNG/JPG, four below-fold images are not lazy, four lack responsive sources, and one is oversized.
findings.suggestedFix: Use responsive modern images, explicit dimensions, and lazy loading below the fold.

findings.summary: The page transfers substantial unused work.
findings.evidence: A 928KB uncompressed stylesheet and roughly 293KiB estimated unused CSS/JS are shipped for a simple portal homepage.
findings.suggestedFix: Purge unused CSS/JS, compress text, and defer non-essential code.

findings.summary: The resource budget is disproportionate to a mostly static portal.
findings.evidence: The 1.72MB load is dominated by 928KB CSS, 184KB fonts, and a 179KB hero image; major hashed assets lack cache headers.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a lean page budget, subset fonts, optimize the hero, and cache immutable assets.
